onboarding.subtitle: Four quick questions, then your dashboard is ready.
onboarding.personaHint: This only changes which categories we suggest. You can edit all of them later.
onboarding.preferencesTitle: How should we show your money?
onboarding.accountHint: Start with the account you use most. You can add the rest any time.
onboarding.openingBalanceHint: What is in it right now. This is recorded as an opening entry, so your ledger balances from day one.
onboarding.allDoneBody: Your workspace, categories and first account are ready. Add a transaction to see your dashboard fill in.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.noAccountsBody: Add a cash wallet, bank account or card to start tracking.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.noTransactionsBody: Add your first transaction to see it here.
transactions.needAccount: Create an account first — a transaction needs somewhere to come from.
transactions.reverseBody: Nothing is deleted. A matching correcting entry is added, and the original stays on record marked reversed — so the history of what was recorded, and when, survives the correction.
transactions.cannotReverse: Only posted transactions can be reversed.
transactions.tagsHint: Press Enter to add. Tags are labels for finding transactions later.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Limits you set. Spending is read from your ledger, never stored separately.
budgets.noBudgetBody: Set a monthly limit per category. Spent and remaining are calculated from your real transactions each time you open this page.
budgets.needCategories: Create a category first — a budget line needs something to limit.

goals.title: Goals & Debts
goals.subtitle: Progress comes from the linked account balance, so it can never disagree with your ledger.
goals.noLinkBody: Link an account to track progress automatically.
goals.noGoalsBody: Set a target and link a savings account. Progress is read from that account, not typed in.
goals.noDebtsBody: Add a loan or credit card account, then record its terms here.
goals.payoffEstimate: About {{months}} months at the minimum payment. Estimate only — it ignores fees and rate changes.

calendar.title: Calendar & Bills
calendar.subtitle: Bills and expected income. Overdue is worked out from today, not from a background job.
calendar.noEventsBody: Add a bill or an expected payment and it will appear here and on your dashboard.
calendar.behaviourNote: Neither option pays anything. NoorixFin never posts a transaction you have not confirmed.
calendar.ruleDeleteNote: Deletes the reminder only. Transactions it already created are not affected.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Every figure is computed from posted entries at the moment you load this page.
reports.noDataBody: Add some transactions and this page will break them down by category.
reports.chartTableNote: The same data as the chart, for screen readers and for copying.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your financial summary

hero.title: Your Money. Your Future. Your Rules.
hero.subtitle: Stop wondering where your paycheck went. Join thousands of individuals, students, and families taking control of their finances with NoorixFin — the simplest, most secure, and completely free personal finance manager.

audiences.title: Built for every stage of your life.
audiences.subtitle: Whether you are tracking pocket money or planning for a mortgage, NoorixFin scales with your ambitions. Real financial growth requires tools that adapt to your reality.

students.title: Students & Bachelors
students.desc: When you're studying or starting your first job, every single dollar matters. You're juggling rent, groceries, student loans, and trying to have a social life. NoorixFin gives you absolute clarity. Split bills with roommates seamlessly, track where your pocket money is actually going, and start building emergency savings before life catches you off guard. Stop relying on mental math and start building financial discipline that will pay off for decades.
students.hook: Imagine knowing, at any moment, exactly how much money you have left for the month — not a rough guess in your head, but a real, live number. Imagine being the one friend in your group who never has to say "wait, I need to check my balance". NoorixFin makes that your new normal.
points: Track every expense — no matter how small
Build an emergency fund before life surprises you
Set spending limits for food, transport, entertainment

families.title: Families & Couples
families.desc: Managing a household budget shouldn't feel like a second job. NoorixFin brings harmony to family finances. Track shared expenses, save for your children's education, and plan that dream family vacation without the stress of wondering 'can we afford this?'. Set unified monthly budgets for groceries, utilities, and entertainment, and get visual alerts when you are nearing your limits. Build a secure future together, with complete transparency.
families.hook: The most common source of stress in any household is not about love — it is about money. "How much did we spend on groceries this month?" "Can we really afford that vacation?" NoorixFin turns those tense conversations into confident, data-driven decisions made together.
points: Unified household budget across all accounts
Save for children's education, weddings, vacations
Visual alerts before you overspend any category
Transparent history — no surprises at month-end

professionals.title: Freelancers & Professionals
professionals.desc: Your income might be unpredictable, but your financial peace of mind shouldn't be. For freelancers, independent contractors, and salaried professionals, NoorixFin acts as your personal CFO. Track multiple income streams, manage tax pools, and monitor your true net worth across banks, credit cards, and investments in real-time. Gain the psychological freedom that comes from knowing exactly what you own, what you owe, and how fast you are growing.
professionals.hook: When your income varies month to month, knowing your actual net worth — not a bank balance, but the full picture across bKash, Nagad, bank accounts, investments, and debts — is not a luxury. It is your compass. NoorixFin gives you that compass, for free.
points: Track multiple income streams and clients
See true net worth across all accounts
Manage tax savings with dedicated envelopes
Recurring bills and reminders — never miss a payment

openSourcePage.title: Why free means free, forever.
openSourcePage.subtitle: NoorixFin is not a company trying to sell your data. We are a Digital Public Good — built like a public park, owned by the community, for everyone.
openSourcePage.content1: Most "free" finance apps are actually data brokers in disguise. They offer you a budget tracker, but their real product is YOUR spending habits, which they sell to credit card companies and advertisers.
openSourcePage.content2: We fundamentally believe that financial privacy is a human right. That is why NoorixFin is 100% Open Source (MIT Licensed). We publish our entire source code online. Anyone can inspect it, audit it, and verify that we do exactly what we say we do.
openSourcePage.content3: This also means NoorixFin can never be acquired by a big bank, shut down, or suddenly locked behind a monthly subscription. The code belongs to humanity now. You can even host it on your own private server if you wish.

aboutPage.title: Our mission to democratise personal finance.
aboutPage.subtitle: Financial literacy and powerful software should not be a luxury reserved for the rich.
aboutPage.story: NoorixFin started from a simple frustration: every good budgeting app either cost 0/month (which defeats the purpose of saving money) or was "free" but aggressively sold our transaction history to marketers. We built NoorixFin to solve our own problem, and open-sourced it so no one else has to choose between their privacy and their wallet ever again.
aboutPage.promise: Our promise: It will always be free. It will always be open-source. Your data will always be yours.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about NoorixFin.

items.a: Yes — completely. NoorixFin is MIT licensed open-source software. There are no plans, no tiers, no credit card required. The hosted instance is free. Self-hosting is free. It will stay free.
Absolutely. Fork the GitHub repo, create a free Supabase project, run the migrations, and deploy the web app to Vercel or any Node.js host. The self-hosting guide is in /docs.

On the hosted instance, data is stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL). Row-Level Security ensures only you can read your data — not us, not other users. If you self-host, your data lives wherever your Supabase project is.
No. There are no analytics scripts, no ad pixels, and no fingerprinting. The only external requests are to Google Fonts and your Supabase project. Your financial behaviour is private.
Any currency — amounts are stored as integer minor units in PostgreSQL, so there is no rounding error. The UI currently defaults to Bangladeshi Taka (৳). Multi-currency is on the roadmap.
Yes — a React Native / Expo app with offline-first architecture. It syncs automatically when online and stores data locally. It is in active development.
Check the CONTRIBUTING.md guide on GitHub. Pick a good first issue, fork the repo, and open a PR. We review pull requests within 48 hours and welcome contributions of any size.
Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 for web, Expo + React Native for mobile, NestJS for the API, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Storage) for the backend. TypeScript throughout. Turborepo monorepo.

items.q: I found a security vulnerability. What do I do?
items.a: Please do NOT open a public GitHub Issue. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting or email security@noorixfin.app. We respond within 72 hours and credit responsible disclosures.

items.q: Can I use NoorixFin for my business?
items.a: NoorixFin is designed for personal and household finance. Business accounting is not currently in scope. The MIT license allows you to fork and build a business tool if you need one.

items.comingSoonDesc: We're currently planning the next set of features based on community feedback on GitHub. Star the repo and join the Discussions to have your say.

securityPage.title: Bank-grade privacy, mathematically enforced.
securityPage.subtitle: We do not just promise privacy — we enforce it at the database level so that a data leak is mathematically impossible.

rls.title: Row-Level Security (RLS)
rls.desc: Imagine a giant vault with millions of safety deposit boxes. RLS ensures your login token is the ONLY physical key that can unlock your specific box. Even we cannot look inside.

noTracking.title: Zero Tracking Pixels
noTracking.desc: We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixels, or any third-party SDKs that secretly record how you use the app.

encryption.title: In-Transit Encryption
encryption.desc: Every byte of data sent between your browser and our servers is secured using TLS 1.3 military-grade encryption.

securityPage.auditBody: Because NoorixFin is MIT licensed, our entire security model is public. Do not trust our marketing copy — trust the math. Read the source code on GitHub.

supportPage.title: Keep NoorixFin free for everyone.
supportPage.subtitle: We don't run ads. We don't sell data. We rely entirely on the generosity of users like you to keep the servers running.

whyDonate.title: Why donate?
whyDonate.desc: Running secure databases and global servers costs real money every month. If NoorixFin has helped you save money or cancel a paid subscription to another app, consider paying a fraction of it forward.

perks.title: Where does the money go?
perks.desc: 100% of donations go directly to our Supabase database hosting, domain renewals, and Vercel compute costs. Nothing goes to salaries.

homePage.privacyTitle: Your data belongs to you. Only you.
homePage.privacyBody1: Most finance apps make money by selling your spending data to advertisers. We think that is wrong. NoorixFin is funded by voluntary donations, not data brokering. Your financial life is private — mathematically enforced at the database level with Row-Level Security.
homePage.privacyBody2: Since our code is fully open source, you do not have to take our word for it. Read every line. Audit it. Host it yourself. That transparency is the point.
homePage.openSourceBody1: Finance is personal. You should never have to blindly trust a company with your most sensitive data. NoorixFin publishes every line of code under the MIT license. If you want to know exactly how we store, encrypt, and protect your data — you can read it right now, on GitHub.
homePage.openSourceBody2: This also means NoorixFin will never be acquired, shut down, or put behind a paywall. The code exists. You can always run it yourself.
homePage.communitySubtitle: NoorixFin is not just software — it is a growing community of people who believe managing your money should be free and dignified.

homePage.donateDesc: If NoorixFin saved you money on subscriptions, consider paying it forward with a small donation.

bugReportPage.title: Found a glitch? Let us know!
bugReportPage.subtitle: Software isn't perfect, but with your help, we can make it incredibly close. You don't need to be a programmer to report a bug.
bugReportPage.whatIsBugDesc: A "bug" is just a fancy word for something not working the way it should. Did a button not click? Did a chart show the wrong number? Did the app crash? That is a bug.
bugReportPage.howToReportDesc: We track all issues publicly on our GitHub platform so everyone can see what we are fixing. Click the button below, sign in (or create a free GitHub account), and just describe what went wrong in plain English or Bangla.
